5289-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5289-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-3240-6277-6462.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

252-4231-5394-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7296.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

654-851-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-851-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

549-5412-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5412-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Coastal Hornclaw.

348-1152-2992-6248-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-6248-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Phenomenon Investigators triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1368-1879-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1879-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5078-6650-7650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-6798-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-1437-1993-3756--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-1437-1993-3756--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7279-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7279-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2281-2511-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-2511-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4668-5078-5402.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1274-3129-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-3129-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2506-2719-6441-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2174-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat.

198-1978-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct or activate Trazyn using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
198-1978-3918.notes: If Trazyn has a charge counter on it, the starting cost is {0},

141-780-2921.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

1274-5641-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
1274-5641-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-4288-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4288-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-2577-5686-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2577-5686-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

713-1497-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
713-1497-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

requires.n: Equipment That Gives Haste to a Creature

1550-2105-6233--78.notablePrerequisites:
Combat Celebrant cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-6233--78.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ardenn triggers, attaching the Equipment that grants haste and Sword of Hearth and Home to Combat Celebrant.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Combat Celebrant
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Combat Celebrant, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Combat Celebrant from exile onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-2793-3743-5089-5636.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
851-2793-3743-5089-5636.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

710-2961-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3197-5783-5786.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creature tokens.
3197-5783-5786.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token that has flying due to Toby.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

565-2450-4668.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
565-2450-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If the chosen permanent is an Island, this combo will net infinite landfall triggers and infinite tapped Island tokens.

2034-3810-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Harried Spearguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Harried Spearguard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Harried Spearguard trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Harried Spearguard from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3011-4475.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-4475.description:
Activate Heartless HIdetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent that started with an even life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2232-2751-3475-4768-4948.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
2232-2751-3475-4768-4948.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Estrid's Invocation and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Estrid's Invocation enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Estrid's Invocation triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Estrid's Invocation and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

262-1064-2335.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Born to Drive attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-1064-2335.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Barrenton Medic has a power of two or greater, it also becomes infinitely large.

1329-1636-2034-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-2034-3652.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-2744-3374.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken white creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-2744-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving the nontoken white creature persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the white creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering its persist ability, returining it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

3554-3617-4635.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Demonic Collusion by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Demonic Collusion and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
